Politically Involved?.description:
Any government or state-affiliated entity that has an
affiliation at a national, regional, municipal, or
international level with the consortium through
endorsement.
Endorsement is defined as statements of support,
adoption, funding, partnerships, formal
recommendations, branding, certifications or
awards, or resource allocation.
These entities can be government agencies or
institutions, state-owned enterprises,
intergovernmental organizations, regional alliances,
etc.

DLT Data Availability.description:
Indicates the amount of data available for the
project regarding DLT.
1. Complete DLT Data: the project provides
public information about the technology or
instance used.
2. Specifies DLT Technology but no DLT
Instance: the project publicly states the use
of Hyperledger, Tendermint, or R3 Corda,
but does not specify which instance.
3. Uses DLT, no specifications: the project
publicly states the use of DLT for the project,
but does not specify any technology or
instance.
4. No DLT data at all: the project does not
publicly state whether they use DLT.

“Failed to disclose” will be used

Utility Integration with Non-SSI Platfor.description:
Platforms, wallets, or services in which the project is
integrated in, which aren’t SSI.
Not all platforms, wallets, or services the project is
integrated with were included in the research, as
this was not a primary focus. Instead, a few
representative examples were added.
Example: Alice's SSI wallets single sign on solution
is used by Bobs Non-SSI LLC.
